verdict.rationale: Docs explicitly document a captcha stance: automatic CAPTCHA solving is enabled by default on every cloud browser, and if the challenge persists, the documented fallback is human control via the live preview — matching the exact automatic-then-human-fallback pattern the story asks for. missing for 10: independent/hands-on verification that automatic solving actually works in practice (only vendor docs cited, no community confirmation of captcha-solving success rate).
